checks.name: Runtime progression and retry behavior are correct
evidence: Automated runtime QA passed initial state, goal-before-item gating, item collection, item hiding/disable, goal success, success retry/reset, and hazard failure.
After hazard failure, calling the same _reset_run path used by Retry moves the player but the next physics frame still sees the prior HazardArea overlap.
The run immediately returns to FAIL: hazard touched, preventing a stable retry after hazard failure.
checks.notes: This is a functional retry defect. It is independent of the visual resource swap but blocks a complete QA pass for the playable slice.

issues.description: Hazard retry immediately fails again because HazardArea.overlaps_body(self) can retain the pre-reset overlap for the first physics frame after _reset_run teleports the player to START_POSITION. Add a bounded post-reset overlap grace or otherwise synchronize the hazard query, then re-run the full runtime transition suite.

notes: WP-041 recommends rework for one major functional retry defect. Art integration, asset status, scene scope, import, runtime loading, and visual hierarchy pass. QA made no implementation edits and hands the defect back to Implementation.
